value.signature: fn take_reserved (buffer : & mut Vec < u8 >) -> Result < Self , TransferError >

review.body: { let scope = crate :: observe :: scope ("INTERCHANGE" , "rule:observe:spans" , "value::budget::Bytes::take_reserved" , & buffer ,) ; let result = if buffer . len () == buffer . capacity () { Ok (Self (mem :: take (buffer) . into_boxed_slice ())) } else { Err (TransferError :: SpareCapacity) } ; scope . finish (& result) ; result }
review.item_premise: Public ownership transfer, refusal and explicit disposal. Full public buffers and outcomes are observed outside the construction budget; the reservation operation observes the full buffer, type/length/capacity and requested storage, and reports usage on refusal. Callback is executable, not serialized. Pointer/capacity and reservation-site controls are not an allocator census. No protected route or loan changes.
